observations.body: Luke summarizes appearances over forty days, teaching, table instruction, promised Spirit, expanding witness, ascension, and the words of two men.
observations.label: Forty days, kingdom instruction, witness, and ascension

observations.body: The passage presents Witness and ascension as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Witness and ascension

observations.body: The passage places Jesus beside Witness and ascension.
observations.label: Jesus

payload.posture: Read Acts 1:1–11 as one movement in the resurrection, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states luke summarizes appearances over forty days, teaching, table instruction, promised Spirit, expanding witness, ascension, and the words of two men. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the resurrection.
payload.title: Forty days, kingdom instruction, witness, and ascension
